_comment: The first-run installer wizard. Server-rendered only, never shipped to a patient's browser.
setup.admin.email_hint: Optional — we'll use it to reset the password if needed.
setup.admin.error_password: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
setup.admin.error_taken: A user with that name already exists — choose another one.
setup.admin.error_username: Enter a username of at least 2 characters, with no spaces.
setup.admin.lede: This will be the panel's first account, with the full administrator role.
setup.admin.totp_later: Set it up later, from the panel
setup.admin.totp_now: Set it up on first sign-in
setup.apikeys.error_env_write: The data package couldn't be registered in the startup configuration (.env file). Check the file's permissions and try again.
setup.apikeys.error_generic: The installation couldn't be completed ({detail}). Try again.
setup.apikeys.error_missing_admin: The administrator account is missing — go back to the previous step and complete it.
setup.apikeys.error_scaffold: The data package couldn't be created ({detail}). Try another name.
setup.apikeys.lede: With an OpenRouter key, the referral-reading AI and the booking chat work right away. You can leave it empty and add it later.
setup.apikeys.openrouter_hint: Get it at openrouter.ai — it starts with “sk-or-”.
setup.apikeys.skip_note: The other integrations are set up later, from Settings.
setup.done.lede: Installation complete. You can now sign in to the panel as “{user}”.
setup.done.settings_note: The other API keys and the fine-grained configuration live in Settings, inside the panel.
setup.done.totp_required: When you sign in, Account will open so you can set up verification with Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator and confirm the 6-digit code.
setup.error_db: The database isn't available right now. Try again in a moment — your answers were saved.
setup.holding.body: It isn't ready for patients yet. Try again later.
setup.holding.title: This site is being set up
setup.language.lede: Which languages will the site be in?
setup.location.error_required: Fill in at least the country and the town.
setup.location.lede: Where does this installation operate? We use it to propose the right data package.
setup.location.proposed: We detected you're in {country} — correct it if that's wrong.
setup.location.province_hint: Leave it empty if your country isn't organized that way.
setup.packs.error_name: Enter a name for the new package.
setup.packs.matched: We found a data package for {town}: “{pack}”.
setup.packs.name: Display name
setup.packs.name_hint: This is what the town will be called on the site (you can change it later).
setup.packs.none_found: There's no data package for {town} yet. We'll create a new one — you'll be able to add the real centers, services and doctors from the panel.
setup.welcome.lede: This assistant will ask for the location, the language and the administrator account. It takes a few minutes and only appears once — as soon as it finishes, this screen stops existing.
setup.welcome.title: Let's set up your installation
